message:
I ordered two collection displays, one purple and one red. They look great, just as described and really good quality. 
I was also very pleasantly surprised to find 2 keychains with a handwritten message included in the package, which honestly made my day! 
Would definitely recommend this seller. Very considerate and efficient, as the order was picked up and shipped quite quickly after I put it in.
